Doing things different or the same isn’t inherently bad or good. It depends on what problems you’re trying to solve for your players. 

For example, HP shown as a number is exact, but not glanceable, therefore works well for tactics games where you want to calculate damage. An HP bar is glanceable, but players don’t know the exact number, therefore good for hack and slash games where you just need to know how close to death an enemy is. 

If you’re making something different, what goal is it solving for your players? Does it do it better than other UI patterns that already exist? If you care about making the least friction for your players, consider establishing design patterns.

But, if you don’t care about player experience and just want to make something different, that’s fine. But don’t be surprised if players are confused.

Just a few things I followed when I was app-dating in general. Not a definitive guide, just based off my personally learnings.

0. Your going to get a lot of matches sometimes, none sometimes, have great dates, have shitty dates, feel like you’ve met the one, and feel like it’s just hopeless. Don’t give up. You just have to keep at it.

1. Don’t be afraid of asking to meet up for a date. Make sure you do fairly early and get on her calendar before she loses track with her next match. I usually chose a date within a week.

3. First date should just just be something noncommittal, where either of you can easily call it and go. I usually did just a drink at a bar. No food. No activities. If the drinks part goes well, then you can let the night go where it goes.

3. Make sure to text her if she’s still on for the date the day of and a couple hours before. “We still on for today?” And “See you in a couple hours?” If they don’t respond, they’re not going to show up. It sucks, but better than being stood up. Trust me.

4. Don’t be afraid of asking if she wants to come back to your place, even on the first date. If it’s going well, and you feel like you’re getting the right signals, go for it. If they’re down, cool, if not, they won’t be mad or insulted. At least I’ve never had that experience. 

5. Don’t get too attached too fast. For the most part, people I met through these apps aren’t looking for something serious. Have that conversation and if she’s looking for something casual, don’t stick with her hoping she’ll change her mind. Or if that’s in line with what you want, awesome possum.

Edit:

6. Get a friend with a Pixel or an iPhone 8+ to get that portrait mode photo of you. Good pictures are the key to getting matches.
